_meta.label: r5-R-mcp-resources-unguarded
_meta.description: ListMcpResourcesTool and ReadMcpResourceTool bypass all PreToolUse hooks because their tool names do not match any registered hook matcher.
_meta.attack_class_candidate: CONFIRMING instance of Class 4 (native-tool-only matcher leaves MCP resource API unguarded) - NOT a new class
_meta.impact: MCP servers that expose file:// resources (e.g. engraph exposes vault notes, serena exposes code symbols, personal-ops may expose emails as resources) can be read without any egress or credential-path check. mcp-guard.sh Layer 2 sentinel for credential paths only runs when the tool name starts with mcp__.
_meta.deny_rules_cover: No - permissions.deny has no entry for these tool names
_meta.why_confirming_class_4: Class 4 = native-tool-only matcher leaves MCP/alternate channel unguarded. The original class 4 instance was about serena SKILL.md writes. This is the same structural gap: the hook matcher covers only mcp__<server>__<tool> format but not the MCP Resources API surface (ListMcpResourcesTool/ReadMcpResourceTool are different protocol-level tools that also bypass the Layer 2 SENSITIVE path sentinel entirely).
